protocol_payload_sha256_of: sorted, compact JSON of the frozen fields below (see app/research/me_short_a_forward_outcome_lineage_v1.py PROTOCOL_PAYLOAD)

enables.purpose: read-only reference-to-execution price alignment counterfactual on matched, matured, finalized outcomes

activation: ME_SHORT_A_LINEAGE_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1 AND DB activation row status=RUNNING with explicit freeze_ts

activation_lifecycle.transitions: READY_TO_START -> RUNNING (explicit freeze) -> COMPLETED/CANCELLED; READY_TO_START -> CANCELLED; terminal states are final
activation_lifecycle.freeze_ts: immutable once set; capture requires strictly signal_time > freeze_ts
activation_lifecycle.evidence_rows: append-only (UPDATE/DELETE blocked by trigger on every capture table)

frozen_geometry.entry_rule: immediate SHORT entry = reference_price (frozen A: max(last five 5m highs))
frozen_geometry.ambiguity_semantics: a candle that touches both stop and target resolves to the STOP and is flagged ambiguous_intrabar; gross_r = -1
frozen_geometry.terminal_path: first touch in the 240m window decides; no touch -> TIMEOUT_240M with exit at the close of the last in-window 5m candle
frozen_geometry.return_at_240m: (close_of_last_in_window_candle - reference_price) / reference_price * 100 — frozen direction-agnostic convention of research.prospective_outcome, so a favourable SHORT move is negative exactly as in the closed frozen OOS cohort

event_key.compatibility: byte-identical to research.me_short_a_fill_feasibility_v1.event_key (migration 077) and to the key used by PR #207
event_key.verification: research.me_short_a_event_lineage_v1 recomputes the key from the stored identity components and quarantines any mismatch; symbol, direction, exact signal timestamp, reference, absolute stop, absolute target, protocol version and protocol hash are all checked

eligibility: every valid new MOMENTUM_EXHAUSTION SHORT candidate strictly after freeze_ts (reference_price > target_1 > 0 and invalidation_price > reference_price); no post-hoc signal filter
backfill: FORBIDDEN — no historical rows, no retro-fitting of source_observation_ids on pre-freeze rows, no mutation of Phase 1 evidence, no mutation of the closed frozen OOS cohort

fields: recent_high_window (the exact five 5m candles whose highs formed reference_price)
source_signal_capture.missing_data: recorded explicitly in missing_fields; never imputed
source_signal_capture.no_lookahead: recent_high_window_end <= signal_time and signal_candle_close_time <= signal_time are hard rejects enforced in code and by DB CHECK

post_signal_candle_provenance.window: the closed 5m candles whose OPEN time o satisfies signal_time < o < signal_time + 240m — identical inequality to the frozen prospective_evaluator window (47 candles for a grid-aligned signal, 48 otherwise; the count is derived from the window, never assumed)
post_signal_candle_provenance.closed_only: is_closed must be TRUE and candle_close_time <= retrieved_at
post_signal_candle_provenance.limit_at_reference_touch: candle high >= reference_price; classified on a candle basis and never presented as a fill
post_signal_candle_provenance.partial_fill: UNKNOWN_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_CAPTURED unless a separate independent capture proves otherwise

outcome_finalization.completeness: candles_expected is derived from the frozen window (never assumed), candles_present must equal candles_expected, candles_missing lists the exact missing open times
outcome_finalization.asof: every used candle must close at or before asof_time (no lookahead); recorded as asof_ok
outcome_finalization.no_premature_finalization: a row is written only after the horizon is settled on closed candles; OUTCOME_UNMATURED rows are never produced by this collector
outcome_finalization.incomplete_source: SOURCE_INCOMPLETE rows carry NO path, NO exit price and NO R/return economics — a source-missing row can never be read as a result
outcome_finalization.retry_idempotency: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING; replay returns False and writes nothing

cost_model.note: frozen ME_SHORT_GEOM_A_EXECUTION_V1 constants, classification only, never retuned

accumulation_gate.meaning: minimum eligibility for the #206 evaluation, not an automatic PASS
accumulation_gate.evaluation: #206 independent executable-entry Net E[R]/PF/CI by notionals 100/500/1000, entry-fee cost attribution, no double-count of reference-to-bid drift/spread, symbol/day concentration

holdout_cohort: every event captured strictly after this protocol's freeze_ts forms a NEW prospective holdout cohort; it is never pooled with the closed 380-row ME_SHORT_GEOM_A_EXECUTION_V1 research cohort
forbidden: modifying the closed frozen OOS outputs
note: No activation, no capture, no backfill until a separate approved deploy/freeze checkpoint. Paper/live forbidden. The frozen A methodology is never modified by this collector.
